query:
select gm.user_id
        from group_memberships gm
        left outer join group_adminships ga
            on ga.group_id = gm.group_id and ga.user_id = gm.user_id
        where gm.group_id = $1
        -- if there's a group adminship, we don't list it
        and ga.user_id is null
        order by gm.user_id
